title: Feeling That It Has Touched: A Torque Residual, a Threshold Above the Model's Error, and a Count of Ticks Before Believing It

questions.question: What is the residual?
options: The torque measured less the torque the model says free motion needs
questions.explanation: Zero in free motion, the contact's torque when it touches.

questions.question: A threshold of 0.05 N m gave how many false alarms with gravity 5 percent out?
Which approach was a harder hit?
questions.explanation: 5.20 N m by the time it stopped.

questions.question: Why is the detection delayed?
options: The residual is filtered and has to stay over the threshold for a count

questions.question: What does the count of ticks protect against?
options: One noisy tick being taken as contact

questions.question: What is not covered?
options: The force at the tip from all the joints
